chunks: And that which Abū Baṣīr narrated from al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, when he said to him:
Does the Imam guarantee the salat (prayer)? He said: “No, he is not a guarantor.”

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: A well-known narrator transmitting this hadith
key_terms.بِضَامِنٍ: One who bears responsibility or guarantees something
key_terms.ٱلصَّادِقِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام, the source of the ruling
key_terms.ٱلْإِمَامُ: The prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Does the Imam guarantee the correctness of the congregational salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses a jurisprudential question about congregational salat (prayer) and clarifies that the Imam does not guarantee the prayer on behalf of others. It indicates personal responsibility within the framework of congregational worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1207 - Abu Basir narrated from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) that when he asked: "Does the Imam guarantee (the correctness of) the prayer?"
Imam (as) replied: "No, he is not a guarantor."
